name: 心声风云四升级版
group_note: 风云Ⅳ (Sumxin fengyun), a Gu Long-novel-themed MUD (sumxin.com/bbs, fy.sumxin.com). Same lineage/bug pattern as wqfy (another 风云 sibling from this pass) though a distinct codebase. WASM pass fixed the classic §8.1 GBK-byte-range is_chinese() bug: adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc's is_chinese() required an even byte-pair length and checked str[0]'s raw byte range (161-254), rejecting valid odd-character-count UTF8 Chinese names; adm/daemons/logind.lpc's own check_legal_name() had the matching i%2 parity gate and a byte-count length bound (2-10, meant to be 1-5 characters per the user-facing '一到五个中文字' message). Fixed is_chinese() to a per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff check and check_legal_name() to check every character with the length bound corrected to 1-5. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (two securityd.lpc candidates exist -- adm/securityd.lpc and adm/daemons/securityd.lpc -- confirmed via SECURITY_D macro that /adm/daemons/securityd is the active one, matching the §7.56 dual-file caution pattern; WIZLIST genuinely read at boot). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB/BIG5 encoding select -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gender (m/f) -> ethnicity selection (0-3) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working score/look commands, zero unexpected errors. Testing note: gender/ethnicity selection landed right after std/char.lpc's heavy first-time compile burst, causing the same test-harness timing race documented on xhcii/xkyxciii -- padding with extra 'm'/'0' sends at --idle 4 reliably got past it; this is a client-timing artifact, not a mudlib defect. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)' with fluffos listed among the top tier. LPC formatter run across all 8238 .lpc files (6459 written, 1775 errors -- almost entirely safe TOKEN MISMATCH safety-gate skips on messy legacy content that doesn't round-trip idempotently, a notably high but harmless skip rate since skipped files are left completely untouched -- 4 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. The one map.lpc file present confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to its pre-format blob. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
